item.title: Gardeners dreaming of spring at Seedy Saturday in Waterford
item.description: Southern Ontario may be in the grip of some paralyzing cold temperatures, but hundreds of people in Waterford were dreaming of warm weather, rich soil and beautiful gardens on Saturday. item.title: Petition urges Norfolk council to reject proposed accommodation tax for overnight stays in county
item.description: An online petition is being circulated calling for Norfolk councillors to reject a proposal that would add an accommodation tax for overnight stays in the county.

item.title: Haldimand County's 10-year capital budget includes $46 million for infrastructure work in 2026
item.description: Haldimand County Council has approved a $382-million 10-year capital budget that includes $46 million in infrastructure investments for this year. The capital budget pays for major assets and long-term investments and is focused on enhancing and building new municipal infrastructure, including roadways, public facilities, parks and recreation amenities. item.title: More than 2,000 local students face suspension for incomplete immunization records
item.description: Grand Erie Public Health says 2,028 local students who haven’t met immunization requirements are facing suspension from school.

item.title: Trillium grant allows agency to harness the power of AI
item.description: A grant from the Ontario Trillium Foundation has helped streamline services provided by a local agency. Through the $99,200 grant, Willowbridge Community Services was able to implement the use of artificial intelligence (AI) technology to securely transcribe client sessions.
